links.outcome: Model true positive rate differences across racial and gender subgroups
links.effect: Models had significantly different True Positive Rates across racial groups but not across gender groups; parity metrics and changepoint calibration testing showed disparities.
links.quote: Through a t-test and ANOVA test of model performance on different subgroups, we demonstrate that the models have significantly different True Positive Rates across racial groups, but not across gender groups.

links.outcome: Effect of reweighting bias mitigation on subgroup disparity
links.effect: Reweighting reduced the disparity in model performance across subgroups; overall accuracy effect not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: When we employed the bias mitigation strategy of reweighting, however, the disparity was reduced.
